name: EmptyState
description: Explains why an area is blank and offers the next step.

children.description: EmptyState content - use EmptyState.Icon, EmptyState.Title, EmptyState.Description, EmptyState.Actions sub-components

size.description: Padding only: sm for a panel or table body, md for a page region. Type and icon never change with size.

when: Lists, tables, or search results with nothing to show
First-run screens before any content exists
whenNot: Failures that need a retry (use Alert)
guidelines: Say why the area is empty, not just that it is
Give one clear action out of the state; two at most, primary first
Match the icon to the cause: search, inbox, folder
Use size="sm" inside a panel, card or table body and the default md for a page region
The state draws no frame of its own; it sits inside whatever already frames the region
Content is start-aligned with the copy around it
accessibility: EmptyState.Title renders a heading (h3 by default); set as to match the outline
EmptyState.Icon is decorative and hidden from assistive tech
Action buttons follow button accessibility guidelines

examples.name: Default
examples.description: First-run state: nothing exists yet, so offer the create action.
examples.code:
<EmptyState>
  <EmptyState.Icon><FolderIcon /></EmptyState.Icon>
  <EmptyState.Title>No projects yet</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>Get started by creating your first project.</EmptyState.Description>
  <EmptyState.Actions>
    <Button>Create Project</Button>
  </EmptyState.Actions>
</EmptyState>

examples.name: No Results
examples.description: A filter or query matched nothing — offer a way back.
examples.code:
<EmptyState>
  <EmptyState.Icon><SearchIcon /></EmptyState.Icon>
  <EmptyState.Title>No results found</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>Try adjusting your search terms or filters.</EmptyState.Description>
  <EmptyState.Actions>
    <Button variant="soft">Clear Filters</Button>
  </EmptyState.Actions>
</EmptyState>

examples.name: With Secondary Action
examples.description: One primary action plus a quieter alternative.
examples.code:
<EmptyState>
  <EmptyState.Icon><InboxIcon /></EmptyState.Icon>
  <EmptyState.Title>Inbox is empty</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>You have no new messages.</EmptyState.Description>
  <EmptyState.Actions>
    <Button>Compose Message</Button>
    <Button variant="soft">View Archive</Button>
  </EmptyState.Actions>
</EmptyState>

examples.name: Small
examples.description: Compact padding for a panel or table body; no icon, no action.
examples.code:
<EmptyState size="sm">
  <EmptyState.Title>No items</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>Add items to see them here.</EmptyState.Description>
</EmptyState>

relations.note: Use Alert for error states with retry

propsSummary: Compound sub-components forward DOM props to their rendered elements
